_id.description: MongoDB document identifier. Accepts ObjectId (driver default) or string (for deterministic ids if needed by integration scenarios).

attributes.description: Free-form per-category attributes (e.g., apparel: {size, color, fabric}; electronics: {voltage, capacity, weight}; groceries: {weight_grams, expiry_days, ingredients_list[]}). Application-layer Pydantic models constrain shape per category. The validator's `additionalProperties: true` setting and the lack of `properties` keys here mean ANY shape is permitted at the DB layer; this is by design (AAP R-7).

brand.description: Brand or manufacturer name. Indexed by application-layer faceted search; not enforced UNIQUE by the validator (multiple products can share a brand).

category_ids.description: Array of category ids (referencing `categories._id`). A product MAY belong to multiple categories (e.g., 'Men's Casual Shirts' AND 'Summer Sale'). Backed by the `idx_products__categories` multikey index. Capped at 32 to bound multikey index cost.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the product was first created. Stored as MongoDB BSON date (millisecond precision). Immutable post-create.

currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, INR, GBP, JPY). Required when `price` is set. The validator does NOT enforce that this is a known currency; the application validates against an ISO 4217 allow-list.

description.description: Long-form product description. May contain Markdown for storefront rendering. Indexed by `idx_products__text_search` (text index on name + description). Capped at 16 KiB to bound document size and text-index cost.

media_ids.description: Array of media ids (referencing `product_media._id`). The order of ids in this array IS the display order; the `product_media.sort_order` field is the authoritative source of truth for display order, but applications may also rely on this array's ordering for fast read-without-join. Capped at 64 media items per product.

name.description: Human-readable product name. Indexed by `idx_products__text_search` (text index on name + description). Multi-language support is provided via attributes.localized_names; this field is the canonical English name.

price.description: Price in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD, paise for INR) IF stored as integer; otherwise the value's units must match `currency` (e.g., USD as decimal). Application code SHOULD prefer Decimal128 for currency-safe arithmetic; `bsonType` accepts integer/long/double for legacy or partially-migrated data. Required at runtime when status is 'active'; not enforced REQUIRED here because draft products may exist without a finalized price.

sku.description: Immutable canonical product identifier (Stock Keeping Unit). UNIQUE across all products — enforced by the `idx_products__sku` index. Pattern restricts to ASCII alphanumeric with underscores/hyphens; spaces and special characters are rejected to keep SKUs URL-safe and grep-friendly. Capped at 64 characters to bound index size.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (lowercase alphanumeric with single-hyphen separators). UNIQUE across all products — enforced by the `idx_products__slug` index. Pattern matches the same regex as `categories.slug` for cross-collection consistency.

status.description: Lifecycle state. 'draft' = not yet visible to storefront (admin-only); 'active' = visible and orderable; 'archived' = soft-deleted (kept for historical order references but hidden from storefront listings). Indexed by `idx_products__status_created` for fast admin filtered listings.

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent update. Backed by the `idx_products__updated` index for event-replay / outbox-reconciliation queries. Updated atomically with the `version` field on every write.

sku.description: Variant-level SKU. SHOULD be unique within the product but the validator does NOT enforce cross-variant uniqueness (the application enforces this at admin-write time).

variants.description: Embedded variant array. Each variant carries its own SKU (variant-level), display name, and optional attributes (color, size, etc., stored in additional properties). Capped at 1024 variants per product to bound document size; products with more variants should be split into multiple parent products.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version counter. Incremented atomically on every update via `findOneAndUpdate({_id, version}, {$inc: {version: 1}, $set: {...}})`. Reads return the current version; writes that pass a stale version receive a 409 Conflict. Initial value on create is 0.
